changelog:
evolution-api v2.3.0

- Adds complete WhatsApp automation via Evolution API v2.3, including text/media/polls/lists/buttons/status messaging.
- Supports advanced integrations: groups, labels, multiple chatbot platforms (Typebot, OpenAI, Dify, Flowise, N8N, EvoAI), webhooks, and Chatwoot.
- Enables proxy and S3 storage configuration for enhanced deployment flexibility.
- Global and instance-level API key authentication now available.
- Detailed instance management, connection, and message feature references included in documentation.
summary: Complete WhatsApp automation via Evolution API v2.3 - instances, messages (text/media/polls/lists/buttons/status), groups, labels, chatbots (Typebot/OpenAI/Dify/Flowise/N8N/EvoAI), webhooks, proxy, S3 storage, and Chatwoot integration
